Messages.Author: Sekreth
Messages.Body:
Can I ask again?

What happens when you use Daemonic Possession on a Merged Vampire? Do
you get both the Merged Vampire or choose 1 of them?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter.

Dorrinal's answer to your query on the WW VTES forum is correct.

See the rulebook for confirmation. "The advancement and the base card are
treated as a single vampire card, even if sent to the uncontrolled region
somehow, until the vampire is burned." [1.5.6]
